name: Dragon's Breath Vial
summary: A vial that lets you exhale a gout of flame once.
description: The vial is warm and the cork has been burned black. Do not drink it near the hay.

stats.effect: When you drink this potion, you can use a Magic action once within the next hour to exhale fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the cone makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.
